coverAlt: Liquid flow calibration equipment inside the Velomac workshop
bodyHtml:
Show the equipment in context

This local draft sample demonstrates a technical image between two paragraphs. It does not introduce new product specifications.

The paragraph following this image keeps its position. Read about Velomac flow calibration systems for the existing technical context.

Use a separate description for each image

  • ALT text describes what is visible.

  • A caption adds context below the image.

  • Placement settings belong to each image instance.

Image context supports understanding; ALT text alone does not guarantee search rankings.

The sample remains a draft. Review the Vortex Flowmeter product page for existing product information.

  1. Select an image to edit its settings.

  2. Preview the body before saving.
